rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is also or additionally true.

example.english: I additionally want another bowl of rice.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 soeng2 sik6 do1 wun2 faan6

rows.note: Use this when presenting an additional, separate point or item rather than simply adding emphasis to the same point.

example.english: Additionally, we need to prepare another document.
example.traditional: 另外，我哋要準備多一份文件。
example.jyutping: ling6 ngoi6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 do1 jat1 fan6 man4 gin6
